Build your own harness, folks!

Stop complaining about companies modifying harnesses however they want. 

It's theirs, not yours!

Instead, build your own. 

This isn't just about implementation disagreements; as models get more capable, the harness will keep adding constraints

posts.text: The thing is, the models are so good and aware of harnesses (at least at a high level) that you can build a good minimal one in a couple of hours. While they are aware, they are not great at the customization you need in a harness. That requires your input and maintenance
